subject: Next steps and calendar windows for product briefing
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@lumina.ai>, Samir Khan <samir@lumina.ai>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps and calendar windows for product briefing

Hi Alicia / Samir —

Thanks again for the call today — good discussion and helpful context on where Lumina is looking to reduce inference cost for batch scoring while tightening latency for a subset of real-time endpoints. Quick recap and a couple of proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

- Recap (short): main priority is lowering per-token cost for model-backed enrichment and standardizing inference across multi-cloud. Key success criteria: <10ms p50 for the real-time workflow and 30–40% per-token cost reduction for nightly batch jobs.
- Next meeting: a 30-minute product briefing + quick tech Q&A to walk through architecture patterns, runtime performance, and a potential pilot configuration. We'll include our SE to orient on integrations.

Proposed 2–3 windows (all in PT):
1) Tue May 4 — 10:00–10:30
2) Wed May 5 — 14:00–14:30
3) Thu May 6 — 09:30–10:00

Please pick the option that works best and flag any other stakeholders who should join (infra lead, data platform, procurement). I attached the short discovery notes and a mutual action plan draft — both are intentionally light so we can update after the briefing.

Attachments: Discovery_Notes_Lumina.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan_Lumina.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@lumina.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir@lumina.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 20:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Next steps and calendar windows for product briefing

Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments, helpful. We like the look of the brief/tech demo format.

We can do Wed May 5 14:00–14:30 PT — that works for both me and Samir. I'd also like to invite our infra lead, Priya Menon (priya@lumina.ai), and our data platform owner, Marco Ruiz (marco@lumina.ai). If your SE can cover integration questions and the KV cache behavior for long-running sessions, that would be great.

Could you send a calendar invite and a short agenda so our team knows what to expect? Also, curious if you can surface any example metrics for throughput/latency on a similar setup (1–2 model variants, mixed batch + real-time).

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product | Lumina AI
alicia@lumina.ai

Great — Wed May 5 14:00–14:30 PT is locked. Calendar invite sent (Google Calendar). Agenda below and a couple of asks so we make the 30 minutes high-value: 

Agenda (30m)
- 0:00–5:00 — Quick introductions and success criteria (Alicia)
- 5:00–20:00 — Product briefing (architecture, runtime tradeoffs, caching & batching) — Jonas
- 20:00–28:00 — Q&A on integration and pilot scope — open
- 28:00–30:00 — Next steps and owners (Mutual Action Plan) — Neha

Pre-reads: I attached the discovery notes and MAP again. Jonas will add a one-page sketch to the invite.

Two quick asks before Wed: 
1) Can Priya (infra) and Marco (data platform) confirm they can join? If procurement will be at the table, let us know so we can bring the expected pricing/contract path.
2) If you have any specific perf targets beyond the p50/p95 numbers you mentioned, send those now so Jonas can prepare targeted examples.

Invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=lumina-briefing-20270505
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/7842

Thanks — see you Wed.
